screen.store_tip: Apps published on xprs.dev/apps. Install with one tap; the trash icon removes an installed one.
screen.settings_tip: Manage the repositories the store reads its catalog from.
group.sources_tip: The store starts with https://xprs.dev/apps. Add another repository as a URL (it must answer with a catalog.json or an index.json) or a Reticulum folder key (npub... or rns:npub...). Only the catalog is fetched; you choose what to install.
